newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal bonds gain but rate cut impact slight.
newsitem.headline: Portugal bonds gain but rate cut impact slight.

text.p: 1655 GMT - Bonds gained but failed to keep pace with other periphery markets with the Bank of Portugal's surprise rate cut having little impact. Outlook positive if dollar stays strong. *Sept 97 futures close 18 points higher at 111.01 *Feb 07 cash (OTC) 102.60 vs 102.45. Yld 6.25 vs 6.27 *Spread vs 10-yr cash Bund 72 basis points vs 70 Thurs close
